data.name: Terraria NPCs
data.description:
Guide: The Guide always offers useful advice and crafting recipes. His origins and unusual connections to this world remain a mystery. Real name: Andrew

Merchant: The Merchant acts as a simple general store of sorts, providing useful starter tools and supplies needed for exploration. Real name: Milton

Nurse: The Nurse's snarky attitude and poor bedside manner may be scary, but for a price, she will cure all that ails a wounded Terrarian. In love with the Arms Dealer. Real name: Heather

Demolitionist: Tread carefully around this dwarf. The Demolitionist is an explosive fanatic and sells dangerous things that go 'Boom!' Real name: Garval

Arms Dealer: The Arms Dealer has everything anyone could need to shoot things dead, from little round bullets to guns made from sharks. In love with the Nurse. Real name: Darius

Dryad: The Dryad is the last of her kind. She is connected with nature and can analyze its purity worldwide. Real name: Tatiana

Tavernkeep: The Tavern Keep once managed a bar in another universe. He's here to help stop the Old One's Army from conquering this world. Now, he manages a bar in your town. Real name: William

Dye Trader: Eccentric and rather snobby to a fault, the Dye Trader has expensive tastes. He is passionate about the materials used in the dyes he sells. Real name: Danel

Zoologist: The Zoologist, resident lycanthrope, adores animals. Her fox-like biology resulted from a cursed animal bite. Real name: Lilith

Golfer: The Golfer is a wise, middle-aged man who sells all sorts of golfing equipment. He's got game and knows how to score. Real name: Jim

Painter: The Painter can talk about all the different shades of colors with which one can paint the walls. He'll sell but a handful of them! Real name: Bruno

Angler: The Angler, a rude fishing genius, sends others to find weird, rare fish. He rewards random items, entertained by any misfortunes. Real name: Danny

Goblin Tinkerer: Exiled from the rest of goblinkind for being an intelligent pacifist, the Tinkerer sells tools for combining accessories into stronger versions. In love with the Mechanic. Real name: Nort

Mechanic: The Mechanic was once imprisoned for her aptitude in engineering. She sells wiring and tool and is know for putting together anything imaginable. In love with Goblin Tinkerer. Real name: Autum

Party Girl: Positive beyond comprehension, the Party Girl will use any excuse to celebrate. She sells party favors and flashy things. Real name: Candy

Wizard: The Wizard is an absent-minded, demented old man who dabbles in the arcane arts. He sells magical trinkets to train new apprentices. Real name: Fizban

Tax Collector: This grumpy Tax Collector has literally been to heck and back. Greedy to a fault, he's truly only concerned with money. He collects taxes from the NPCs. Real name: Fillmore

Clothier: Once trapped under a curse, the Clothier is the master of thread. Though he is a bit of a jerk, and hates everyone. Real name: Nigel

Cyborg: The Cyborg was built with the combined efforts of the Mechanic and the Steampunker to aid in rocket science and world defense. Real name: Delta

Steampunker: The Steampunker has a particular taste for steam-fueled machinery and gadgets. She sells her gizmos with an endearing accent. Real name: Whitney

Witch Doctor: It's unusual for a Lihzahrd to be outside the Temple. Even more unusual are the voodoo things he sells. He prefers his jungle digs. Real name: Konah

Stylist: The Stylist loves style, gossip, and hair. Aside from performing a miracle makeover, she sells some hair product as well. Real name: Roxanne

Pirate: Ahoy! The only good Pirate Captain is... one that sells cannons and weapons to take out all competing Pirate Captains! Yarrr! Real name: Red Beard

Truffle: Harnessing the hidden power of the glowing mushroom, the Truffle forges weapons and tools exclusively in his mushroom home. Real name: Enoki

Princess: Shy and innocent, this happy young lady sees the positive in everything, and everybody. She appreciates all of her subjects, from all walks of life. Real name: Yorai
